bug_semantics: containerd CRI copies OCI image-config labels (Dockerfile LABEL) onto the created container via buildLabels/BuildLabels with only size/format Validate(), not a reserved-namespace denylist. Those labels include containerd.io/restart.loguri. The restart monitor reads that label and passes it to cio.LogURI, so a binary:// URI from an untrusted image can execute a host command as the containerd daemon. ctr's WithImageConfigLabels (c.Labels = config.Labels) is the same copy for non-CRI. Reachable after an image pull/create on a node with the restart plugin enabled.
flaw_origin: First written in f40df3d72ba85700c737aca2cb21212d8f0caaed (Phil Estes; PR #6012). That commit changed CRI buildLabels to take imageConfigLabels and copy every key with `for k, v := range imageConfigLabels { labels[k] = v }`, and added WithImageConfigLabels doing c.Labels = config.Labels. Parent d081457ba486b7c5c1e9f218f755b038061d90bc's buildLabels copied only CRI request labels. 6bfd09f7c91c042a2ce6c2a1025c88e2975395b6 is an explicit cherry-pick of f40 onto the 1.6/main line (carrier into the GHSA 1.7+/2.x range), not a first-write. Later Validate() skips oversized labels only. The binary:// sink (d656fa38ca32fc0e08f31b74169552f371bbd4e0, 2020) already existed; the new causal surface is the untrusted image-config copy.
